original_summary: Event-driven pipeline to validate PRs, post Slack updates, and sync status to Jira.
essential_elements: Single entrypoint: /validate endpoint or CI job
Run lint + tests + security scan with clear pass/fail
Post one consolidated status to GitHub Checks
Notify Slack only on failure or on main branch
Store minimal run metadata for audit (repo, sha, outcome)
complexity_sources: Multiple queues (SQS + Redis) for same workflow
Custom rules engine for simple gating logic
recommended_simplifications: Use one CI workflow (GitHub Actions) with sequential steps
Emit a single GitHub Check summary; link to logs
Send Slack only when outcome changes or failures
Replace rules engine with YAML config + if/else gates
notes: Keep scope to PR validation; defer Jira sync until users ask for it.

original_summary: Multi-tenant analytics service with custom OLAP store and real-time dashboards.
essential_elements: Define 3 core metrics and their event schema
Ingest events via HTTP batch endpoint
Persist events in Postgres (partitioned by day)
Expose read API for aggregated metrics (hour/day)
Basic auth + workspace scoping
complexity_sources: Building UI dashboard inside backend scope
recommended_simplifications: Start with Postgres + materialized views for aggregates
Batch ingest every 30–60s; skip streaming
Return JSON for charts; let frontend render
Add tenancy via workspace_id column + RLS later

original_summary: Customer support triage bot that routes tickets, suggests replies, and updates Zendesk.
essential_elements: Fetch ticket text + metadata from Zendesk webhook
Classify into small set of queues (billing, bug, access, other)
Suggest a reply draft with citations to internal docs
Human approves before sending
Log outcome + final queue for learning
complexity_sources: Two LLM providers with fallback logic
Building a full knowledge graph upfront
recommended_simplifications: Require human approval for all outbound replies
Start with 5 queues max; add when needed
Use one LLM provider; handle errors with retry + degrade
Use simple doc index (search) instead of KG
notes: Key is auditability: store prompt, sources, and approval decision.

original_summary: Internal tool to manage feature flags with rollout rules, segments, and SDKs.
essential_elements: CRUD for flags (boolean + percentage rollout)
Targeting by user_id allowlist/denylist
Serve flags via low-latency read endpoint
Cache flags in app with TTL
Audit log for changes
complexity_sources: Building client SDKs for 6 languages immediately
Complex segment builder with nested boolean logic
recommended_simplifications: Ship HTTP read API + JSON schema; SDKs later
Support only allowlist + percent rollout initially
Use polling with ETag/If-None-Match instead of push
Model envs as separate workspaces or simple enum
notes: If latency is a concern, add CDN caching before push infra.

original_summary: ML-powered expense categorization with receipt OCR and auto-reimbursement.
essential_elements: Upload receipt image + amount + merchant
Run OCR (managed service) to extract text
Categorize into small fixed categories
Let user confirm/edit before saving
Export CSV for accounting
complexity_sources: Automatic reimbursement payments on first pass
Large taxonomy mapped to multiple accounting systems
Building fraud detection from day one
recommended_simplifications: Use AWS Textract/Google Vision for OCR
Keep categories to ~10 and allow manual override
No payments: only export + approvals
Defer fraud checks to simple rules (duplicates, limits)

original_summary: Federated search across Confluence, Google Drive, and GitHub with permissions.
essential_elements: Connectors for 1–2 sources (start with Drive + GitHub)
Index title + snippet + URL + ACL principals
Search endpoint with query + workspace context
Enforce access at query time
Clickable result list with source filters
complexity_sources: Trying to support every SaaS connector upfront
Custom vector database plus keyword index
Real-time indexing on every change event
recommended_simplifications: Start with 2 connectors; add via plugin interface later
Use Postgres full-text + optional embeddings for rerank
Store ACL as principal IDs and filter in SQL
Batch re-index nightly + manual refresh
notes: Make ACL correctness a hard requirement; ranking can be mediocre at v1.

original_summary: IoT device fleet management with firmware updates, metrics, and remote commands.
essential_elements: Register devices with device_id + model + owner
Report heartbeat + firmware version
Show fleet list + last_seen + status
Upload firmware and mark latest per model
Rollout firmware in batches with pause
complexity_sources: Custom MQTT broker plus HTTP API
Multi-step canary logic with ML anomaly detection
Building mobile app alongside web console
recommended_simplifications: Skip remote shell; only support fixed commands later
Start with HTTPS polling; MQTT optional later
Simple staged rollout (5%/25%/100%) with manual pause
Ship web console only
notes: Telemetry: store only what you chart; raw metrics can go to S3 later.

original_summary: Automated SOC2 evidence collection with agent installs and continuous monitoring.
essential_elements: List required controls and evidence types
Integrate with 2 sources (GitHub + AWS)
Pull artifacts on schedule (weekly)
Store evidence files + metadata + timestamps
Generate auditor export bundle
complexity_sources: Supporting every compliance framework at once
Complex workflow engine for evidence approvals
recommended_simplifications: No agents; use SaaS APIs + cloud read-only roles
Schedule pulls; no real-time alerts initially
Focus on SOC2 Type II only
Simple checklist approvals in UI; no workflow engine

original_summary: B2B billing portal with invoices, usage, and self-serve plan changes.
essential_elements: Sync customers + invoices from Stripe
Show invoice list + PDF download
Display current plan + next renewal date
Allow updating payment method
Support email receipts and dunning via Stripe
complexity_sources: Usage metering pipeline before pricing is stable
Role-based access with complex org chart
recommended_simplifications: Use Stripe Customer Portal for plan/payment changes
Start read-only billing UI + links to Stripe PDFs
Defer usage-based billing until metrics settle
Keep roles to admin + member
notes: Avoid shadowing Stripe logic; use webhooks only for local cache.

original_summary: On-call scheduling app with rotations, escalations, and SMS/voice alerts.
essential_elements: Create schedules and rotations (weekly)
Assign users to rotations
Trigger alerts via webhook -> SMS
Acknowledge/resolve endpoints
Basic reporting: MTTA/MTTR
complexity_sources: Building calendar sync in multiple providers
recommended_simplifications: Start with SMS only + simple retry
Hardcode 1–2 escalation steps in config
Web UI only; responsive design
Add Google Calendar sync later if requested

original_summary: Data pipeline to sync Salesforce leads to HubSpot with dedupe and enrichment.
essential_elements: Fetch leads changed since last sync
Map a small set of fields to HubSpot contacts
Upsert by email with conflict logging
Run nightly with manual rerun option
Send summary email with counts + failures
recommended_simplifications: One-way nightly sync; handle deletes later
Start with 8–12 fields; log unmapped fields
Use managed cron (Cloud Scheduler) + one worker
Skip opportunities; focus on leads/contacts only
notes: Dedupe rules must be explicit: email primary, fallback to domain+name only with review.

original_summary: Developer portal to manage API keys, usage limits, and docs for partners.
essential_elements: Issue/revoke API keys per partner org
Authenticate requests with key header
Enforce simple rate limits per key
Expose usage stats (daily counts)
Publish OpenAPI docs + quickstart
recommended_simplifications: Use API keys only; add OAuth later
Scopes: read/write max; keep minimal
Quota: per-key requests/day + burst limit
Use static docs site generated from OpenAPI

original_summary: Roadmap tool with OKRs, dependencies, and auto-generated status updates.
essential_elements: Create initiatives with owner + due date
Link initiatives to 1–3 OKRs
Weekly status update prompt + summary
Simple dependency links (blocks/blocked by)
Export to CSV
recommended_simplifications: Ship list + detail views; defer Gantt
Status is user-entered; optional templates
Keep roles: admin/editor/viewer
Dependencies are links only; no scheduling math
notes: Later plan replaced with a simpler OKR-only tracker.

original_summary: Reworked roadmap tool focused on lightweight OKR check-ins and initiative notes.
essential_elements: Track OKRs with target + current value
Weekly check-in per OKR with short note
Initiatives as freeform notes linked to OKRs
Simple dashboard: on track / at risk / off track
Slack reminder to owners weekly
complexity_sources: Dependencies and auto-scheduling features from prior version
recommended_simplifications: Remove dependencies entirely; keep only links
Manual status tags (on track/at risk/off)
Use basic charts from a UI kit
Support one scoring model (percent complete)
notes: Supersedes earlier initiative-heavy design; keep it boring.

original_summary: MCP-style agent that can deploy services, manage secrets, and provision infra.
essential_elements: Define allowed actions (deploy, rollback, view logs)
Use one deployment target (e.g., Fly.io or ECS)
Require approval before any write action
Record every action with inputs/outputs
Provide clear rollback path
complexity_sources: Supporting multiple clouds and IaC engines
recommended_simplifications: Pick one platform and one repo layout
Permission-gate actions with an allowlist
No infra provisioning; assume services exist
Keep workflows linear; one action per request
notes: Safety over autonomy: approvals + audit log are the product.

original_summary: Client-side feature experimentation platform with bucketing and analytics.
essential_elements: Define experiments with variants and traffic split
Deterministic bucketing by user_id
Expose assignment via SDK or HTTP endpoint
Track one conversion event per experiment
Basic results table (counts + conversion rate)
complexity_sources: Bayesian stats engine + sequential testing UI
recommended_simplifications: Start with fixed-window stats; show simple rates
No identity stitching; user_id required
Batch process events hourly
Manual review to stop experiments

original_summary: Knowledge base cleanup project: migrate Notion docs to a searchable handbook.
essential_elements: Identify top 50 pages by traffic/usage
Define canonical structure (teams, product, ops)
Migrate with redirects and ownership
Add lightweight search + tags
Set review cadence (quarterly)
recommended_simplifications: Migrate as-is; rewrite only top pages
Manual tags for key sections only
Use existing permissions; don't mirror across systems
Use a static site generator or Notion export
notes: Assign page owners; stale pages get archived, not endlessly revised.

original_summary: Prototype crypto payments checkout with multi-chain support and custody options.
essential_elements: Accept one payment method (USDC on one chain)
Generate invoice with amount + expiry
Confirm payment via provider webhook
Mark order paid and notify customer
Provide refund/manual reconciliation process
recommended_simplifications: Pick one chain + one token + one provider
Custody via provider; no wallet ops in-house
Skip analytics; just track invoice status
Manual refunds initially
notes: Removed after compliance review; keep learnings but do not ship.

original_summary: Incident postmortem generator that turns timelines into a structured write-up.
essential_elements: Collect incident metadata (sev, start/end, services)
Capture timeline entries with timestamps
Generate draft sections (impact, root cause, actions)
Require human edit + approval before publishing
Track action items with owners + due dates
complexity_sources: Deep integrations with every monitoring tool
recommended_simplifications: Use manual timeline input; integrate later
Pull only basic metadata from PagerDuty optionally
Always require review step
Action items: simple list with reminders
notes: Best v1 output is a draft people want to edit, not a final truth machine.
